modules.phonation-synthesis.source_and_t: Source and target WAV → Extract F0 → Edit and apply control points → Generate current or six groups → Listen and save. Each input is limited to 10 seconds, 480,000 frames, and 8 MB. Desktop requires no login; web inputs and results are subject to project permissions and quotas.
modules.phonation-synthesis.original_aud: Original-audio F0 determines LPC analysis intervals; residual F0 is used for pulses and the continuum. F0 extraction intervals are in milliseconds, internal trajectories use a 1 ms grid, and LPC frame length and step are in samples. Editing F0 reuses the original LPC, residuals, and pulses.
modules.phonation-synthesis.normalized_a: Normalized alignment maps voiced duration to 0–100%; onset alignment retains each duration. Synthesis follows the original method, resampling valid target F0 onto source analysis intervals. CSV saves complete 1 ms source/target trajectories. Blank control points are unvoiced; interpolation between valid internal points follows the original implementation.
modules.phonation-synthesis.period_energ: Period energy matching actually matches the target residual period's absolute peak. Output loudness matching matches mean absolute amplitude over the full interval; these switches are independent. Peak limits apply to each step after resynthesis. Endpoints remain affected by the source vocal-tract filtering and amplitude processing for the current direction.
modules.phonation-synthesis.after_each_g: After each group finishes computing, all its files are saved together. The six continuum groups are generated sequentially. Complete groups are retained after cancellation or failure and can be recovered by refreshing history. Later parameter edits do not alter generated results; playback and export always read the group's snapshot. Saving uses an independent group folder without overwriting previous results.
